[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Archer]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] lead a '''squadron''' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. It consisted of at least seven [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], flown by at least a few [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilots]]. They were charged by the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] with chasing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']].

==Behind the scenes==
Archer's squadron appeared in [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[James Luceno]].
